definitions.gloss: ultimate, extreme, final, the very last
definitions.explanation: The furthest possible point or the highest degree of something. Used both in serious contexts (philosophy, goals) and in casual, emphatic contexts (marketing, food descriptions).

examples.japanese: {究極|きゅうきょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}られた→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
examples.english: I was forced to make the ultimate choice.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{究極|きゅうきょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This is said to be the ultimate ramen.

examples.japanese: {究極|きゅうきょく}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: Ultimately, you have no choice but to decide for yourself.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun modifier ({究極|きゅうきょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～) or with ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ as a na-adjective or adverb ({究極|きゅうきょく}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). In everyday Japanese, frequently used hyperbolically to describe something as the best or most extreme of its kind, especially in food and product marketing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {究極|きゅうきょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧: ultimate choice
- {究極|きゅうきょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧: ultimate goal
- {究極|きゅうきょく}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ultimately, in the final analysis
- {究極|きゅうきょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美味|おい}しさ: ultimate deliciousness
